rules.who: Real people only. (1) The defensive coordinators of the 2026 season, as the repo already sources them in data/vip/defense_identity_2026.json (the club's coaches page names each one), with one change since that file was checked: the Panthers fired Ejiro Evero on 2026-10-30, so he is listed as available. (2) Recent head coaches who are not head coaches in 2026: those who opened the 2024 or 2025 season as a head coach and lost the job, and whose 2026 role could be confirmed from a club page or a news report.
rules.not_here: The 32 sitting head coaches (they cannot be hired by another club); offensive coordinators who were never head coaches (offensive coordinators come in a later release); anyone whose 2026 situation could not be confirmed; anyone who left football (see left_out).
rules.status: employed = on a 2026 NFL staff, so a club hiring him leaves a vacancy; available = no NFL staff job in 2026 as of the date above.
rules.side: The side of the ball he comes from (his coordinator background), not his current title.
rules.kind: Why he is listed: coordinator = one of the 31 defensive coordinators of the repo's 2026 defense identity file; former_head_coach = added because he lost a head coach job in the 2024 or 2025 season and is not on that list. Whether he has been a head coach is head_coach_record, not kind (several coordinators are former head coaches).
rules.defense_identity_note: Copied from the baseline_role of that coordinator's row in data/vip/defense_identity_2026.json: a developer note about which 2025 defense his numbers come from, not display text.
rules.names: ASCII first and last names as they would be written into a coach record; together at most 24 letters.
rules.head_coach_record: Derived from nflverse games.csv (regular season and playoff games 1999-2025 that he coached, interim spells included where the file lists them); null when he has none in that window. The file lists no interim coaches for 2024 and 2025, so a coach fired during one of those seasons is cut at his firing date (in_season_exits: Allen, Eberflus, Callahan, Daboll; each with its source). Earlier careers are not counted.
rules.as_of: A snapshot: NFL staffs change during the season (the Evero change is the example). Rebuild with tools/nfl2k5_coach_owners_build.py to refresh.
